description: Source code implementing Wi-Fi Connection Admission Control (CAC) logic, including management of associated devices, management frame handling, event processing, and telemetry reporting.

methods.name: cac_print
methods.description: Logs messages to a specific log file with timestamp.

methods.name: telemetry_event_cac
methods.description: Sends telemetry data related to CAC deny events, with different telemetry buffer names based on hotspot security type.

methods.name: cac_event_exec_start
methods.description: Handles start event for CAC execution, logs start message.

methods.name: cac_event_exec_stop
methods.description: Handles stop event for CAC execution, logs stop message.

methods.name: get_minrate_from_mcs
methods.description: Retrieves minimum rate from MCS index based on operating standard, bandwidth, and MCS index.

methods.name: cac_event_exec_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event for CAC, performs device association cleanup and enforces CAC policies based on various thresholds.

methods.name: exec_event_cac
methods.description: Dispatches CAC-related events such as start, stop, and timeout.

methods.name: cac_mgmt_frame_event
methods.description: Processes management frames (probe, assoc, reassoc) for CAC, performs threshold checks, and responds accordingly.

methods.name: cac_event_webconfig_set_data
methods.description: Handles webconfig set data event for CAC configuration updates.

methods.name: webconfig_event_cac
methods.description: Dispatches webconfig events related to CAC configuration.

methods.name: cac_event_hal_assoc_device
methods.description: Handles association of a device, updates internal device map, and logs connection.

methods.name: cac_event_hal_disassoc_device
methods.description: Handles disassociation of a device, updates internal device map, and logs disconnection.

methods.name: hal_event_cac
methods.description: Processes HAL events related to management frames and device connection status, dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: cac_event
methods.description: Main event handler dispatching different CAC-related event types.

methods.name: cac_mgmt_frame_hook
methods.description: Intercepts management frames (probe, assoc, reassoc) for CAC processing, used for hotspot VAPs.

methods.name: cac_init
methods.description: Initializes CAC application, creates necessary hash maps.

methods.name: cac_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes CAC application, destroys hash maps.
